title: Collateral Protection Insurance — Insurance Requirement Terms for the Borrower's Own Policy
content:
Under Collateral Protection Insurance, the borrower keeps their own physical-damage insurance on the financed vehicle and gives the company proof of it. The terms below set what that insurance and its proof must show, plan by plan, from CollateralGuard Plan A to CollateralGuard Plan F.

## Highest deductible the borrower's own policy may carry

| Plan | Highest comprehensive or collision deductible (USD) |
|---|---|
| CollateralGuard Plan A | 500.00 |
| CollateralGuard Plan B | 500.00 |
| CollateralGuard Plan C | 1000.00 |
| CollateralGuard Plan D | 1000.00 |
| CollateralGuard Plan E | 1000.00 |
| CollateralGuard Plan F | 1000.00 |

## Requirements common to every plan (A through F)

| Requirement | Value in each of Plans A, B, C, D, E and F |
|---|---|
| Physical-damage coverages the borrower's own policy must carry on the financed VIN | comprehensive and collision |
| Exact lienholder and loss-payee wording the policy must show | Harborline Acceptance Corporation ISAOA ATIMA, P.O. Box 650212, Dallas, TX 75265 |
| Whether proof is rejected when the company is not listed as lienholder and loss payee | yes |
| Whether the policy must list the contract's exact 17-character VIN | yes |
| Who must be a named insured on the borrower's policy | the borrower or the co-borrower |
| Channels through which proof of insurance is accepted | the insurer's electronic feed, an insurer fax, an insurance agent call, and a declarations page upload |
| Whether an insurance binder is accepted as proof | yes |
| Longest binder period accepted as proof | 30 calendar days from the binder effective date |
| Minimum calendar days between the verification date and the policy expiration date for proof to be accepted without a renewal | 15 |
| Calendar days after the contract is funded within which proof of the borrower's own insurance must be verified before the record moves to lapse notice | 30 |
| Calendar days a premium billing is held pending proof review while borrower-submitted proof is under review | 10 |
| Whether an insurer's reinstatement of the borrower's policy without a gap counts as continuous coverage | yes |
| Whether one borrower policy listing several financed VINs may satisfy each of those contracts | yes |

## Points of application

- The deductible ceiling applies to the comprehensive deductible and to the collision deductible separately; each must be no higher than the plan's figure. Under CollateralGuard Plan B, a deductible of exactly USD 500.00 meets the figure and USD 750.00 does not.
- The verification-date figure is counted in calendar days: with a hypothetical review date, a policy expiring 15 calendar days later meets it and one expiring 14 days later does not.
- A binder whose period runs 30 calendar days from its effective date meets the binder limit; a 31-day binder period does not.
